durable_lessons: A single governing thought does not rescue a sentence that still serializes multiple protected functions as a coordinated list.
Concrete safety/control terms must still be audited for hidden enumeration even when they are semantically related.
A final consequence sentence is explanatory aftercare when it merely restates the criterion established by the preceding sentence in evaluative form.
Do not advance the reader-question chain while the current movement still contains either hidden enumeration or explanatory aftercare.
When the mainline only needs the governing control idea, route the detailed control functions to later safety custody rather than forcing them into one sentence.
